notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/cinematronics/nl_boxingb.cpp (NETLIST_START(boxingb), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/boxingb-sound.nets.

Compared with the audio board schematic 72-11516-00 "Audio Board 'BB'" rev X14, sheets 1-6 (doc 4cc749f9b585 pp94-99, native 300 dpi), 2026-10-20: all 55 ICs' types; the input conditioning from J2 (OUTPUT 0-4 and 7 on J2-11 to J2-16, through D25-D30, U50, U40, U30, R177/R180/R181 and C67/C69/C70) and the serial latches U49/U39 into U48, U38 and U47; the crystal oscillator, U23, U13/U9/U29 and the divide-by-eleven music clock U43/U24/U33/U44; the noise register U1, U11, U12, U32, U35; every sound channel -- bell, chirping birds, dying bug, egg cracking, beetle on screen, bounce, cannon, loud and soft explosions, bug pushing -- with its 566s, 555s and CA3080s; the music generator U46/U36/U37, U25, U34, U15, U35, U45 and its CA3080 U67 with Q31-Q34; and the summing amplifier U54 with the CS follower U55 all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value (R9-R209, C11-C75), transistor and diode orientation included. The manual has no audio board parts list. Corrected from the sheet, none of it in a sound path: U25 pin 5 is unconnected and U2's spare inputs 5, 9 and 11 are grounded (MAME's line 786 ties "U25.5" to ground, a typo for U2.5); U58's discharge pin 7 is unconnected, not grounded; Y1 is a 20 MHz crystal, not an ideal clock; and U20 pins 3-6 are the shaft encoder's (sheet 5), not bare pins.

Drafting slips where MAME follows the part, not the label: U1's second half is labelled clock 12, CLR 13 (the 74LS393 is the other way round); U9's second half K 10, CLR 11; the dying bug's 39K is labelled R31 (it is R37 by position, as MAME has it); R196 is labelled R96. Not in this file: the shaft encoder (sheet 5, which also carries U6, a 74LS74 MAME's list of omitted parts leaves out), the regulators (U69 7815 and U68 7915 on the sheet, the other way round in MAME's comments) and +2.2V reference, and the final amplifier.
conflicts: The sheet labels U36's LOAD (pin 9) "MLOAD+", where U46 and U37 beside it read "MLOAD-". MAME uses MLOAD- on purpose ("schems say MLOAD_P, but solarq says MLOAD_M"), the theory text (p35) says all three counters load on M Load-, and on MLOAD+ the middle four bits of the divider could never count. This file follows MAME.
The theory text (p33) takes the beetle oscillator's output from U20-4; the sheet and MAME take it from pin 2, and sheet 5 gives U20 3/4 to the shaft encoder.
